snippet.title: Frog Knight – Official Steam Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Climb out of a cursed pit as a daring frog wielding a talking sword.
Bounce off floating orbs, master precise jumps, and face the risk of losing everything with a single fall. No checkpoints. No mercy. Just the climb.

The official Steam demo is now available!
Try the first section of the massive vertical world and discover the core bounce-based movement that defines Frog Knight.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3897830/Frog_Knight/

Follow the development:
Twitter: https://x.com/mechanical_maze

Instagram: https://instagram.com/mechanicalmaze
